text: Hey, we also applied for the partner process while i was still in Germany. I had an interview at the embassy before i received my final entry invitation. I can't remember how long it took from interview till i got the entry letter, but it wasn't immediate. Germany is also a visa-exempt country. This was back in 2020. (It was Corona, this may have been a reason for the extra interview as the borders were closed, but not sure)
